nom: Vichy Minéral 89 Eyes Hyaluronic Acid Eye Gel Cream

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin found the gel left under-eyes feeling dry and had to layer another cream, and another with oily/combination skin reported it hydrated without adding oil.
segments.dry: Several reviewers describe dry or very dry skin around the eyes and report the gel deeply hydrates and locks in moisture, though one reviewer with dry eyes still found it not moisturizing enough and another felt it left skin drier than before.
segments.combination: One reviewer with oil-prone, combination skin reported intense hydration without added oiliness or breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no stinging, irritation, or breakouts and good makeup wear, while others describe an allergic-type reaction with clusters of small bumps under the eyes and on the hand where the product was dispensed.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s to 70s report visible lifting of hooded/droopy eyelids, softened crow's feet, and reduced dark circles, though one mature reviewer felt it needed layering with another product for fuller results.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report smoother crow's feet, softened fine lines, and firmer or lifted lids, including a droopy-hooded-eyelid case in a nearly 70-year-old; a few say it did not reduce wrinkles or brighten as advertised.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe strong, fast-absorbing hydration and plumping under the eyes, but a handful report the opposite — dryness appearing minutes after application or no real moisturizing effect.
concerns.redness: One reviewer describes pink, puffy, swollen eyelids as part of an allergic reaction, while most others report no redness or irritation.
concerns.barrier: A small number of reviewers report an allergic reaction with bumps and swelling developing after previously tolerating the product, one linked to a dermatologist-confirmed sensitization.
concerns.spots: Three reviewers describe clusters of tiny white or skin-colored bumps appearing under the eyes and on the hand after use, in one case taking over a week to clear.
concerns.blemishes: No reviewer discusses acne or blemish breakouts specifically tied to this eye product beyond the bump/allergic-reaction cases already noted under spots.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin report the gel does not add oiliness or greasiness, and one specifically found it hydrating without exacerbating oil.

aspects.libelle: Allergic bump reaction after repeated use
Elegant glass bottle and pump packaging
Product hard to fully dispense near bottle's end
No noticeable results after weeks of use

extraits.titre: Not for sensitive skin - left clusters of bumps.
extraits.texte: Used product in the evening. The next morning, I noticed a cluster of tiny white bumps on the back of my hand where I'd dispensed the product. I looked in the mirror and was horrified to see the skin under both eyes were covered in the same bumps. It took over a week for them to clear. I felt so humiliated and had to wear sunglasses because people kept asking what had happened and if it was contagious. I use Vichy's Liftactiv Eye & Lash serum every morning and have never had issues or any adverse reaction, I'm not sure why my skin reacted so horribly to this product.

extraits.titre: Nice at first, but now it triggers dermatitis.
extraits.texte: This brand was recommended by my dermatologist. I liked the thin consistency of this gel (which soaks into skin far more easily than creams). It didn't brighten the skin around my eyes as advertised, but the hydration helped my wrinkles not look nearly as pronounced. I used the gel every-other-day (3-4 days a week) in the evenings. To use, I'd wash my face and hands, dispense one pump onto the back of my hand, and dab the gel along my orbital bone with my ring finger. This worked fine for a while, but recently I seem to have developed an allergy to the product. I woke up the other day to see a cluster of tiny bumps on the back of my hand (in the same spot where I dispense the gel). I looked in the mirror and my eyes (the lids of which were pink and puffy), were ringed by clusters of the same tiny bumps. My routine is extremely minimal, and this gel is the only product I dispense on the back of my hand or use near my eyes, so I know this product is the culprit. I spoke with my dermatologist, who says it's not uncommon to develop an allergic reaction to something you've successfully used without issue before (especially if you have sensitive skin) and advised me to throw out the remainder of the product. I'm pretty bummed, as I did really like it initially. While my hand has cleared up and most of the redness and swelling around my eyes is gone, I still have clusters of bumps on my crow's feet. Hopefully they fade soon - they make the skin around my eyes look sun damaged! :(

extraits.titre: One of the rare products that works for me
extraits.texte: I'm almost 70. My eyelids now have droopy hoods. I've tried several eye creams, eye retinol, etc. Nothing. I didn't expect much from this. Hyaluronic acid never does anything for me and I doubted volcanic water could do what other creams couldn't. I just bought it to get free shipping and a free sample. Whatever it is in this product, the HA, the volcanic water or the gel like consistency, it actually made a noticeable difference in my eyes, especially the droopiest right eye. Always skeptical, I at first assumed it was a passing thing having to do with hydration or sleep position. However, it's worked every day. Some days a little more lid than others, but always visible lid, whereas before using this I was completely hooded on my right eye. It did take a few days to a week before I noticed it. (You can tell how much I anticipated the result by the fact that I didn't even think about it.) I just happened one day to realize, "Hey. I think my eyes are better." And I waited another week before I'd believe that the stuff was actually working. I now always have a spare bottle. I never want to run out. The Lift-Activ HA does nothing for my face or sagging. This Mineral 89 Eye Gel, however, is one of maybe 3 products that have ever made a noticeable difference. After all of this, my caveat is that just because it worked for me doesn't mean it will for you. But this is a subjective review of my own experience. I have oily skin and don't need anything really aggressive; however, I did have to use another cream to combat the dry feeling. One bottle does last a long time and I am glad I had a few months to try it out.
Miineral 89 eyes really is everything they say, I have extremely dry skin and it deeply hydrates the eye area, which needs extra attention. I love it

I bought a full set of vichy mineral. I like it a lot especially this eye product. I have a very dry and sensitive skin and my eyes need extra care. The texture is light with thin smell. I bought it twice already and not going to stop to use it)

Pretty good product and packaging. I'm a fan of this product. I absolutely love the superior hydrating properties of this serum as it provides intense moisturisation without exacerbating problems of oil prone, combination skin - hydration with zero oil is a total winner! The serum really did plump my skin which reduced the appearance of fine lines making for a more youthful appearance. I also noticed my skin had a more healthy looking glow which was still apparent even after foundation application. The serum was also beneficial to my under eye area, in fact, it was better than many eye creams I've tried.
